name: Calcium polystyrene sulfonate
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Hyperkalemia in acute or chronic kidney insufficiency, including dialysis (oral)
usual_adult_dose.dose: 20 g 1 to 3 times daily in about 150 mL liquid, with food; stop when potassium reaches 5 mmol/L
40 g in 150 mL 5% glucose 1 to 3 times daily, retained 6 hours, after a cleansing enema

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Aluminum or magnesium hydroxide, calcium carbonate
key_interactions.action: Separate doses by at least 3 hours.

key_interactions.effect: Toxicity if hypokalemia or hypercalcemia develops.

contraindications: Obstructive bowel disease or reduced gut motility; risk of colonic necrosis

pk.bioavailability: Not absorbed (calcium released is partly absorbed)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: None; excreted in feces with bound potassium
